fact: Seventeen officers of Benin's data protection authority (APDP) were sworn in before the Court of First Instance of Cotonou on 14 September 2026 under Article 468(2) of the Digital Code, on the instruction of the APDP president.
Me Luciano Hounkponou, president of the Apdp-Bénin, spoke as panellist at the MTN Group Fintech Summit regulators' forum in Johannesburg, 1 to 3 September 2026.

The APDP's published 2025 report, as relayed by La Nation, gives 907 files examined and 793 validated (606 authorisations, 187 declarations), 782 cases handled by its control and litigation service, 64 inspection missions, 20 complaints treated and 75 compliance certificates issued.
The APDP, led by president Me Luciano Hounkponou, published its annual report for 2025 on its activity under the Digital Code.

At the ID4Africa 2026 AGM panel, the advisor and rapporteur of Benin's APDP said Benin set up the APDP as one piece of the broader ecosystem; the document is dated 2026-05-16 and gives no other date for the event.
